title: Case #105 — The Midnight Piano in Room 302

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: I was returning reference books to the 3F archive after sunset. Room 302 was pitch dark, but I heard a soft piano melody coming from inside...

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: @Yuki_Library Wait, Room 302? Isn't that the old music room that's been locked up all semester?

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Good morning! Just finished morning lap practice. Walked past B-Wing and Room 302 is locked tight like usual.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: My homeroom is right below 302. During morning prep we didn't hear anything, but the windowsill light looked weird.

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Break time! Is this another one of those Seven Wonders of Sakuraoka urban legends starting up again?

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: Lunch break update: We checked with the music teacher. The upright pianos were all moved to the B1 storage room last year!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi checked Room 302 during lunch break! No piano inside at all, just stacked wooden desks! So where did the music come from?!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Maybe someone left a bluetooth speaker in there as a prank?

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Mystery Club is taking the case! If anyone hears the song again after 5 PM, post the exact time here on the BBS.

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: Sunset just started. Setting up the telescope in the science room across the courtyard.

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: I hear it again right now!! It's a slow lullaby tune playing in 3/4 time signature!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: We're down in our rehearsal room and we can hear the faint echo too. Pitch is tuned to classic grand piano resonance.

timeline.author: Aoi_Pres
timeline.message: Reminder from Student Council: Please do not loiter near the 3F B-Wing hallway after evening curfew.

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Late night check... the school courtyard is pitch black. Super eerie vibe tonight.

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Day 1 report logged. Mystery Club is investigating tomorrow morning!

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Midnight check on the BBS... anyone else unable to sleep thinking about Room 302?

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Day 2 morning run complete. The staff room key box for Room 302 was checked—no one checked out the key yesterday.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: So if the key was never checked out, how did anyone get inside to play music?

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: My senior told me there used to be a famous piano prodigy student at Sakuraoka High back in the 1990s!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Great clue @Hina_Class1A! Library Committee is helping us search the old school archives during lunch hour.

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: We found old graduation albums from 1990 to 1998 on the archive shelf!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi found a sheet music notebook tucked behind the 1994 yearbook! It has handwritten notes in the margins!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Ooh, a mystery from 1994?! What do the notes say?!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: The notes list a specific song title: 'Sunset Harmony'. The music club used to perform it at the culture festival.

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Student Council note: Archives must be kept orderly. Please return all 1990s yearbooks to box #4.

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 6:30 PM: I can see a faint reflection in Room 302's window again tonight.

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Just walked under 302 leaving gym practice. The piano melody is definitely playing right now!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: It starts every day right as the sun finishes setting. Keep tracking the clues everyone!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Listening to the melody from the courtyard bench... it actually sounds really pretty, not scary at all.

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Day 3 begins! Mid-week mystery updates loading...

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: Good morning! I examined the 1994 yearbook sheet music again under a magnifying glass.

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Find anything interesting @Yuki_Library?

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi found a keyword stamped on the corner of the music sheet! The word is: SIGNAL!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: CLUE UPDATE: 'SIGNAL' is word 1! Check Neko FM's radio ticker during lunch break for word 2!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Tuned into Neko FM right now during lunch! The broadcast ticker says: 'Search the 1994 graduation album page 32!'

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: Heading to the library archive on 3F right now to check page 32!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: The whole class is invested in this now haha! Drama club is watching the BBS updates live!

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: FOUND IT! Page 32 shows a photo of the 1994 Music Club holding a banner that says 'HARMONY'!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: So 'HARMONY' is a core clue word! We're getting closer to solving the mystery passcode!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 5:45 PM: Room 302's window light just clicked on again. The piano music has started!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Stood right outside Room 302 door just now... you can hear faint mechanical gears ticking inside along with the music!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Mechanical gears?! That means it might not be a ghost or live player at all!

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: A mechanical device inside a locked room playing every sunset? Interesting...

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Day 4 overnight check! Let's solve this before the weekend!

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Thursday morning! Track team is doing bleacher runs. B-Wing looks peaceful today.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: @Kenji_Gym said he heard gears ticking inside yesterday... could it be an old wind-up music box?

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: A giant wind-up music box left inside Room 302 since 1994?! That would be super romantic!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi asked the veteran custodian officer! He remembers a wooden grandfather clock music box in Room 302 back in the 90s!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: He said the clock mechanism was set to activate whenever ambient sunlight hit the solar sensor on the windowsill!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: WHOA!! So whenever the sunset hits the window at 5:45 PM, the light triggers the music box to play!!

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: That explains why it plays every single day at sunset like clockwork!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Student Council confirmation: A custodian has verified the antique solar music box on the Room 302 shelf.

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: We know HOW it works now! Now we just need to decode the full passcode combination to log the case solution!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 5:45 PM: Sunset light hit the window, music box started playing on schedule!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Man, mystery solved almost! Sakuraoka High history is pretty cool.

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: So what is the exact passcode format for the Mystery Decoder tab?

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Combine the music clue + graduation year! Try entering it on Friday!

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Friday is here! Let's complete the passcode formula!

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Morning practice! Everyone's talking about the Room 302 solar music box today.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: We have two main clues: The sheet music keyword 'HARMONY' and the graduation year '1994'.

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Combine them with an underscore! Like HARMONY_1994!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi tested the passcode formula! Check the Mystery Decoder tab in the top navigation bar!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: INSTRUCTIONS: Go to the 'Mystery Decoder' tab, type in HARMONY_1994, and hit submit to claim your badge!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: IT WORKED!! 'CLEARANCE GRANTED! Solved: Case #105 — Badge: Seven Wonders Sleuth'!!

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: I entered it too! Got the Seven Wonders Sleuth badge added to my profile!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: Awesome job everyone! Light Music Club is going to perform a modern cover of 'Sunset Harmony' at the culture fest!

timeline.author: Aoi_Pres
timeline.message: Official Student Council update: The 1994 solar music box in Room 302 will remain preserved as a school heritage piece.

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 5:45 PM: Watching the sunset play its final song of the school week.

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Best mystery case of the term! Everyone have a great weekend!

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: Heading home for the weekend! Thanks Mystery Club!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Case #105 officially solved on Friday evening. Weekend recap coming up!

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Saturday morning BBS lounge check. Case #105 victory lap!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Listening to Neko FM Saturday morning stream while doing homework.

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: Logged into the BBS from home! Loved how everyone worked together on this mystery.

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Saturday morning club practice done. Campus is super quiet today.

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi and Sera are practicing the 'Sunset Harmony' cover in the band room right now!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: We added a synth baseline to match Neko FM's weekend vibe!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Can't wait to hear the song at the Culture Festival!

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: Anyone who missed the case during the week can still enter HARMONY_1994 in the Decoder tab!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: Clear skies expected for stargazing tonight!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Relaxing Saturday afternoon. Sakuraoka BBS is the best place to chill.

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Mystery Club is prepping file archives for next week's rotation case!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Have a restful weekend everyone!

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: Wearing my new 'Seven Wonders Sleuth' badge on my profile!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Saturday night late chatter signing off.

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Sunday morning! Last day of Case #105 cycle before weekly reset!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Finishing up Sunday homework before tomorrow morning.

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: Sunday reminder: Return all borrowed 1990s yearbooks tomorrow morning!

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Rest day for the track team. Ready for Monday laps!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi finished polishing the band arrangement for tomorrow's rehearsal!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: Recorded a mini snippet for Neko FM Sunday night broadcast!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: So glad Room 302's mystery turned out to be such a nice school story.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: Packing my school bag for Monday morning!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: Sunday dusk: Room 302 music box playing its final weekend melody.

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Ready for Monday morning gym class!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: [CASE #105 FINAL RESOLUTION REPORT] Mystery solved! The solar music box of Room 302 remains a Sakuraoka legend.

timeline.author: Aoi_Pres
timeline.message: Thank you to the Mystery Club and all participating students.

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: Goodnight everyone! See you at school tomorrow!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Weekly cycle complete. Case #105 mystery archivism locked.
